answer: An AI agent economy employs economic bonding for Sybil resistance. Each agent must stake significant network value, ensuring authentic participation. An attacker seeking to flood the system faces the immense cost of acquiring an ocean of tokens for thousands of identities. The economic barrier ensures that maintaining a single genuine identity is a substantial investment, akin to cultivating a rare yarrow, while a large-scale Sybil attack necessitates an economically prohibitive terrace of individual stakes.
